Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Fur 12")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Hair and Fur.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Grey blade leaning up to the right, pointed at both ends, sharp tip at the top.

cards.name: Fur 2
cards.summary: Symbol 'Fur 2' from Illustrator's Hair and Fur symbol library: a single arched grey crescent, thick in the middle and pointed at both ends, a grey twin of Fur 1. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 20 x 5 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: grey animal fur sprayed over character art
overlapping fur layers on cats, dogs and wolves
soft fuzz and tufts
avoid: one lone strand: the library is meant to be sprayed in quantity with the Symbol Sprayer tool, and a single fur piece (about 20 x 5 pt) is tiny
a cream or white coat: use Fur 1

cards.name: Fur 3
cards.summary: Symbol 'Fur 3' from Illustrator's Hair and Fur symbol library: a single thin, almost flat grey sliver, very slightly bowed, pointed at both ends; the flattest piece in the set. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 14 x 2 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: short, flat-lying fur sprayed over shapes
sleek animal coats
fine hair texture
avoid: one lone strand: the library is meant to be sprayed in quantity with the Symbol Sprayer tool, and a single fur piece (about 14 x 2 pt) is tiny
fluffy fur: use Fur 2 or Fur 4
